In `sync_contacts` (`practice_crm/sync.py`), I moved the `SyncSession` construction out of the retried `attempt` closure and into the function body, before the closure is handed to `retry_with_backoff`.

It's now `session = session or SyncSession(batch)`. A caller-supplied session is still used, and every retry shares the same instance. Each retry therefore resumes from `session.pending()` and never rebuilds the session or re-creates a contact an earlier attempt already recorded. That removes the duplicate writes. The module docstring and the `SyncSession` docstring are unchanged.

`python -m pytest -q` passes (3 tests). I did not run the vaccination scenario with 429s injected in the geo lookup, so the duplicate-contact failures themselves are untested here.
